purpose: Actual registered cloud publisher/consumer timestamp and large-message delivery diagnosis; no navigation acceptance
clock: Single explicit BEST_EFFORT KEEP_LAST depth1 /clock subscription; original integer Clock stamp; no additional rclpy TimeSource or synthetic clock
receipt: Every actually delivered callback preserves integer header stamp, receive monotonic wall, current actually received Clock stamp and age, original frame, PointCloud2 fields/shape/stride/data bytes, and available actual MessageInfo fields. No payload decoding, copying, hashing, interpolation or republishing.
observer_complete_requires: Observed at least60sim seconds from first actual clock
All four subscription streams actually received
analysis: Compare unique source stamps, DDS publisher sequence if available, matching actual odometry stamps, payload byte distribution, delivery gaps and current source age; unavailable MessageInfo remains null.
limitations: Paired subscribers share one lightweight process and publisher
Reliable reader may change retransmission/backpressure of the shared publisher
Endpoint and loaded middleware evidence only identifies what was actually observed, not every transport path
observation_complete never means every cloud was delivered, motion passed, navigation passed or a DDS cause was proven
